recipe.name: Modernisation Engine — approved isolated verification
evidence: Operator-approved project-local recipe; uses the existing test runner without changing it.
Requires the pre-existing private control directory, operator environment, reference/benchmark mounts and pinned offline rootless image.
The existing runner enforces network=none, read-only source/reference/benchmark mounts and fixed process/memory/CPU limits.
No dependency bootstrap, image preparation, host pytest, application startup, source/test edits or guard changes.
Receipt/log paths are emitted by each runner invocation; this is verification of the configured development suite, not release acceptance.
